mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the 3-month Treasury yield (measured by GDPC1) over the next month is associated with a forward discounting effect that increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in flattening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index (above 0.2%) coincides with a forward discounting effect that reduces the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in inflation spikes are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment (above 50,000) coincides with a forward discounting effect that increases the present value of expected equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in strengthening labor markets are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-month rolling window.
